import sys,runpy,subprocess,time
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import probe_reading
original=probe_reading.reading_phases
def profiled(probe,*args):
 name=subprocess.check_output(['docker','ps','--filter','ancestor=oimobbs:reading-scaling-diag-20261023','--format','{{.Names}}'],text=True).strip()
 assert name and '\n' not in name
 subprocess.run(['docker','kill','--signal','USR1',name],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 time.sleep(.3)
 try: return original(probe,*args)
 finally:
  subprocess.run(['docker','kill','--signal','USR2',name],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
  time.sleep(.5)
probe_reading.reading_phases=profiled
runpy.run_path('scripts/probe-thread-resources.py',run_name='__main__')
